name: VegvisAI open index: political parties in Norway
policy: Every party in Partiregisteret can be listed on the same terms: links to its own public pages, in alphabetical order, never ranked, free of charge. A listing is not an endorsement, and a party that is missing is not less relevant. Parties can ask to be listed, changed or removed.
notice: Unofficial listing made from the parties' own public pages (P34). The list is not complete yet: more parties are welcome.
